title: QR Codes
summary: Scan and create QR codes and barcodes, with a warning before risky links.
description:
Scan any QR code or barcode and see what it holds before anything happens: a link shows its real website first, a Wi-Fi code shows the network, a contact card shows the name. Every scan is kept in your history, and you can create your own codes to show or share.

- **Safe links:** the website is shown first, and an odd-looking address is flagged.
- **History and favourites,** with notes.
- **Create codes:** QR, EAN-13 and Code 128.

**What it never does:** no ads, no tracking and no account. Scans stay on this phone; a link opens only when you choose to open it.
